description: This file defines the MethodResultColumn class, which implements the IColumn interface for benchmarking purposes. It provides methods to retrieve and format benchmark results, invoke workload methods via reflection, and determine availability and default status within benchmark summaries.

classes.name: MethodResultColumn
classes.description: A class implementing IColumn to extract and format method results from benchmark cases, using reflection to invoke setup, workload, and cleanup methods.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted value of the benchmark method result for a given summary and benchmark case.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Overloaded method that includes style parameter to return the formatted benchmark method result.

methods.name: CallMethod
methods.description: Invokes the workload method of a benchmark case via reflection, including setup and cleanup, and returns the result or null if invocation fails.

methods.name: IsDefault
methods.description: Indicates whether this column is the default for the given summary and benchmark case.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the method result is available in the benchmark summary reports.
